rows.label: Docker Desktop (WSL 2 backend)
rows.what: Docker Desktop running its engine in WSL 2.

facts.text: Per-user install is recommended and needs no admin; needs WSL 2.1.5+; Windows 10 22H2 (19045) or Windows 11 23H2 (22631)+; virtualization on
WSL itself is installed with wsl --install from an administrator PowerShell, then a restart

operator_commands.installer: Run 'Docker Desktop Installer.exe' and choose the per-user install

rows.label: Docker Desktop for Mac
rows.what: Docker Desktop (Apple silicon or Intel build).

facts.text: Supported on the current and two previous macOS majors; at least 4 GB RAM; Rosetta 2 optional for some amd64 tools

operator_commands.installer: Open Docker.dmg, drag Docker to Applications, start it and approve the privileged helper prompt

rows.label: Docker Engine (rootful)
rows.what: Docker Engine from Docker's apt/dnf repository.

facts.text: Install via the official repository; published ports bypass ufw/firewalld
The docker group grants root-level privileges

operator_commands.debian: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl && sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc && echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io
operator_commands.fedora: sudo dnf -y install dnf-plugins-core && sudo dnf config-manager addrepo --from-repofile https://download.docker.com/linux/fedora/docker-ce.repo && sudo dnf install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io && sudo systemctl enable --now docker

rows.label: Docker Engine, rootless
rows.what: Engine in rootless mode: daemon and containers run as your user.

facts.text: Needs uidmap and at least 65,536 subordinate UIDs/GIDs

operator_commands.debian: sudo apt-get install -y uidmap dbus-user-session docker-ce docker-ce-rootless-extras

rows.label: Docker Desktop for Linux
rows.what: Docker Desktop running a VM on Linux.

rows.label: Podman
rows.what: Podman, rootless by default; on macOS and Windows a Podman machine VM.

facts.text: Rootless by default; podman machine init / start on macOS and Windows
On Windows the default machine provider is WSL; Hyper-V optional
DOCKER_HOST points Docker tools at Podman
